exec_summary.headline: AI-guided screening reached 27.2% solar-cell efficiency, found 33 hidden MXenes, and ran robotic telescopes.
exec_summary.body: A Nature Synthesis screen narrowed 90,000 generated molecules to 300 and reached 27.2% perovskite efficiency. Linköping used AI database mining to find 33 overlooked MXenes and make 11 new ones, while hobbyists let agents book robotic telescopes and file asteroid positions.

exec_summary.headline: Creators got video agents and one-prompt design edits, while hobbyists shipped a PS2 emulator in a browser tab.
exec_summary.body: Riverside launched four video agents that produce, edit, clip and post. Canva's Brush model restyles a deck from one prompt, and a creator used Claude Code to cut a ten-minute vlog from raw clips.

exec_summary.headline: Solo builders used agents to ship a 6,454-video feed, a 340,000-commit law archive, and revenue-bearing products.
exec_summary.body: Karpathy had Claude build HackerTube in about two hours. An architect reports permit-grade house plans in twelve hours, and small teams shared concrete customer and traffic outcomes.

exec_summary.headline: Personal agents moved onto phones and chat, from proactive text updates to restaurant bookings.
exec_summary.body: ChatGPT added text access to its Dot assistant, Grok Bot added Pages and dashboards, and an on-device Android agent gained 3,860 stars in three days. Zest books restaurant tables from a group chat.

exec_summary.headline: Agents got cheaper or local, with faster task runs and a 125-billion-parameter model on a Mac.
exec_summary.body: A side-by-side build test found Terra averaged 23:43 against Opus at 43:52. DeepSeek Flash costs under a dollar per task in Cursor, while Slotstream streams a large open model on Macs.

exec_summary.headline: MCP and skills became a shared plug across Android, Google, Cursor, and Basecamp.
exec_summary.body: Google opened more than 50 connected apps through MCP and Android AppFunctions. Cursor released an Agent SDK, and Basecamp joined Claude's app directory.

exec_summary.headline: Gemini 4 Carbon led a new model wave alongside Terra and Mistral's one-trillion-parameter release.
exec_summary.body: Google says Gemini 4 Carbon ranks first on Artificial Analysis. OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra for computer use, and Mistral opened the weights for Large 4.
